duster.headline: Diesel-auto stock is thin; 2022 TechRoad Auto at R249 900 is the clean criteria fit, 2022 Zen manual is the value play.

shortlist.note: 2022 TechRoad Auto, R249 900, 47 051 km, +R12 185 — only cheap low-km diesel auto; fits all criteria
2022 Zen, R209 990, 72 000 km, +R24 273 — biggest bargain, diesel 2022, but manual
2019 Dynamique Auto, R195 000, 88 500 km, +R5 717 — cheapest diesel auto; pre-2020, high km

alerts: Avoid 28074226 (R269 990, -R37 033) and 28745083 (R284 900, -R26 707) — badly overpriced; 28728171 at Kia multifranchise suits the Duster trade-in

caddy.headline: Extremely thin market: one 2020 Crew Bus at R279 990/76 000 km — inside both caps, but it's a Crew Bus, verify carefully.

shortlist.note: 2020 1.6 Crew Bus, R279 990, 76 000 km — only listing; petrol Kombi-style, inspect before committing

alerts: Single-listing market — widen radius or wait for fresh panel van/Kombi stock

jimny.headline: Three 3-door Jimnys under caps; 2018 1.3 cheapest at R234 890, 2021 GLX lowest-km at 25 115 km.

shortlist.note: 2018 1.3, R234 890, 86 000 km — cheapest, older gen; budget pick
2021 1.5 GLX AllGrip, R295 995, 25 115 km — lowest km, near cap; no dealer shown
2020 1.5 GLX AllGrip, R289 890, 78 000 km — newer-gen middle option

alerts: All three are 3-door as preferred; no 5-doors in budget

seltos.headline: Petrol EX autos carry the value; R210 000 2021 EX Auto is cheapest but sits exactly on the 100 000 km mark.

shortlist.note: 2021 1.6 EX Auto, R210 000, 100 000 km, +R37 692 — cheapest auto; at km limit, verify history
2023 1.6 EX Auto, R274 990, 44 000 km, +R26 946 — newest, low-km, cleanest fit
2022 1.6 EX+ Auto, R234 900, 97 876 km, +R13 700 — multifranchise dealer, good for Duster trade

alerts: 28682451 manual EX, R189 900 (+R44 930), is the market's biggest undervalue if manual is acceptable

creta.headline: Diesel autos start at R249 990; 2021 1.6D Executive fits criteria best, 2024 Premium Auto adds low-km value.

shortlist.note: 2021 1.6D Executive Auto, R249 990, 98 000 km, +R15 779 — cheapest diesel auto; high km
2024 1.5 Premium Auto, R279 999, 40 000 km, +R26 362 — newest gen2, low km
2021 1.5 Premium manual, R199 990, 81 000 km, +R33 653 — gen2 bargain but manual

alerts: 28597538 (2019, R199 990) is gen1: 400 L boot, 1.6 motor — not the 433 L gen2

hr-v.headline: Thin market: only two old-gen CVTs, no hybrid in cap; 2021 Comfort at R249,990/57k km is the value pick.

shortlist.note: 2021 Comfort CVT, R249,990/57,000 km — old gen, 448L boot + Magic Seats; cheapest entry.
2020 1.8 Elegance CVT, R298,900/50,000 km — more power/trim but R49k premium hard to justify.

alerts: No 2022+ hybrid within cap — boot-size tradeoff not in play yet.

corolla-cross.headline: Two 2021 XS at ~R250k lead on value (+R17-20k under model); no hybrids listed; verify the cheap 2024 Xi.

shortlist.note: 2021 XS, R249,990/36,300 km, estUnder +R20,200 — best value; Toyota resale intact.
2021 XS, R249,999/29,000 km, +R17,488 — lowest km under R250k; compare service books.
2024 XS, R269,999/42,342 km, +R17,109 — newest XS with strong value.

alerts: 2024 Xi at R259,990/22,294 km (Westown) is suspiciously cheap near-new — verify history before trusting the +R14k estimate.

mg-zs.headline: Baseline: nine facelift units, all 2025-26 with 443L boot; expect alerts as this fresh capture moves; best entry R249,900/9,906 km.

shortlist.note: 2026 Comfort, R249,900/9,906 km, +R17,809 — cheapest; CMH Suzuki Pinetown.
2026 Luxury, R269,900/5,000 km, +R18,922 — top value but no dealer shown; verify seller.
2026 Comfort, R249,950/14,700 km, +R8,681 — near-identical price alternative.

haval-h6.headline: Baseline: six units; 2022 2.0T autos from R279,990 fit the brief; skip the 2019 1.5T manual at 98,759 km.

shortlist.note: 2022 2.0T Premium, R279,990/51,300 km — cheapest proper H6; GWM/Haval Hillcrest good for Duster trade.
2025 2.0GDIT Premium, R299,900/40,000 km — newest, lowest km, at cap edge.
2022 2.0T Luxury, R297,880/53,294 km — higher trim, ~R18k over the Premium.

peugeot-2008.headline: Baseline: five gen2 6AT units from R229,990; wet-belt service history is the make-or-break check on every candidate.

shortlist.note: 2024 Active, R239,950/30,000 km — newest low-km value; demand wet-belt evidence.
2022 Allure, R229,990/55,000 km — cheapest, higher trim; verify wet-belt history carefully.
2025 Active, R259,950/32,000 km — clean low-km 2025 if budget stretches.

discovery.headline: Only MG ZS (443 L, all autos) clears the 430 L bar; Omoda C5 qualifies only via 2025+ X Series (442 L); rest fall short.

shortlist.note: 443 L clears bar; all 6 listings autos, budget-fit; growing MG dealer network.
Conditional add: only 2025+ X Series hits 442 L; standard C5's 378 L fails.
